method: Direct City Open Data API extraction; published numbers preserved. No census PDF content used in this replacement.
geographyVintage: 2022 community boundaries applied to2021 census data, as stated in dataset metadata. Community changes since2022 may prevent exact joins.
populationUniverse: People living in private households; collective dwellings excluded.
unavailableReason: Not present in the verified open replacement datasets; retained as external profile links only pending a separate licence basis.
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary.
statcanAttribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population, 2021. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
limitations: This is2021 data, not a current estimate.
Published counts/percentages are rounded and may not sum.
Null means absent source data; zero means a numeric zero explicitly present in the source.
Use community code for joining; do not assign census statistics to individual residents or quadrants.
Missing or renamed community codes must stay unmatched rather than receive inferred figures.
